title: At most one primitive label per Hecke eigensystem at a chosen place (via Galois representations of lifts)
summary: If an injective linear map L sends the forms of principal level on V to definite algebraic forms, makes every form of a Hecke eigensystem p spherical with fixed eigenvalues at the split places off the level, and intertwines the parabolic action at a chosen place x up to psi(det) and distinct characters chi_l(det) of orders dividing M_omega (parahoric type), then at most one primitive label occurs in the p-part at x (no existence is asserted: if the p-part vanishes, no label occurs). Each occurring label c gives, by Frobenius reciprocity, a product label of L(y); L(y) is an eigenform for one family Q of Hecke polynomials that depends only on the eigenvalue functions F(w), not on c or y, so it has an attached 2-adic Galois representation r, and every representation attached to Q is labelled at x by the twist of c and the chi_l (Attached.isLabelledAt, which the authors call local-global compatibility at tame level; its identification with the published theorems is open, see that import's literature record). Hence one r attached to Q is labelled by both twisted labels; at a tame inertia element s, every eigenvalue of r(s) is then an M_omega-th root of unity (distinct irreducible labels have no common root), so the product of the roots of the first twisted label, a primitive (q - 1)-th root of unity with q - 1 > M_omega, would have M_omega-th power 1.

members.name: Data.isEigenform_of_hasHeckePolyAt
members.text: Let D be admissible data over P, n a finite type, M a type, f a function from G_f(E(D), n) to the functions M -> C, f nonzero, and Q a family of complex polynomials indexed by the finite places of E(D). Assume that at every finite place w split off the level (IsSplitOffLevel(D, w): w split, neither w nor its conjugate a chosen place) f has Hecke polynomial Q(w) at w (HasHeckePolyAt: the maximal compact subgroup at w fixes f, each Hecke operator T_{w,j} acts on f by a scalar t_j, and Q(w) = sum_j (-1)^j q_w^(j(j-1)/2) t_j X^(|n|-j)). Then IsEigenform(f, Q): f is nonzero, and for all but finitely many finite places w of prime norm, w is split and f has Hecke polynomial Q(w) at w.

members.name: Data.occurringLabels_subsingleton
members.text: Let D be admissible data over P, s signs on RowIndex(D), V a hermitian space over E(D) with signs s, n a nonempty finite type, v : RowIndex(D) -> n an embedding, and L a linear map from principalForms(D, V) to the algebraic forms LevelForm(S, J, chi', kappa, nu) on I_n (S a system of places, J a level, chi' a level character, kappa a weight and nu a determinant exponent). Let p be an eigensystem, F a family indexed by the finite places, x a chosen place of D, m a natural number, b an assignment of blocks, chi = (chi_l) for l < m characters of the residue field k_x and psi a character of k_x. Here F assigns to every finite place w of E(D) a function F(w) : C -> C (one scalar F(w)(X) for every complex number X, not a list of eigenvalues). Assume: (hL) L is injective; (hF) for every y in eigenPart(D, V, p) and every finite place w split off the level, IsSphericalWith(rightRegular, w, F(w), smooth form of L(y)): the smooth form of L(y) is fixed by the part of K_0 above w and conj(w), and for every complex number X the Hecke polynomial operator heckePolyOp(w, X) = sum_{i=0}^{|n|} (-X)^i q_w^(binom(i, 2)) T_{w,i} acts on it by the scalar F(w)(X); (hk) for every y in principalForms(D, V), the smooth form of L(y) has parahoric type at x (HasParahoricType) with embedding v, blocks b, characters psi and chi, and the function g -> L(principalRep(D, V)(g at x)(y)) of g in GL_{RowIndex(D)}(k_x), the general linear group of the residue field at x; (hchi) chi is injective; (hpsi) psi^(M_omega) = 1; (hM) chi_l^(M_omega) = 1 for every l, where M_omega = Mω(P, s(D)). Then occurringLabels(D, V, p, x) has at most one element. (No existence is asserted: a label occurs only through some y in eigenPart(D, V, p) that its idempotent does not kill, so if eigenPart(D, V, p) = 0 no label occurs.)

imports.name: HasParahoricType
imports.lean:
def HasParahoricType f hw (e : ρ ↪ n) b (ψ : MulChar (ResField w) ℂ) (χ : Fin s →
  MulChar (ResField w) ℂ) (F : GL ρ (ResField w) → _) := (∀ i, b i = 0 ↔ i ∈ range e) ∧ ∀ k x h,
  submatrix (reduceGL k) e e = x.1 → rightRegular ℂ _ (M → ℂ)
  (atSplit hw k.1) f = (∏ l, χ l (blockHom b l.succ ⟨reduceGL k, h⟩).det.1) • ψ x.det • F x
imports.text: HasParahoricType(f, hw, e, b, psi, chi, Phi) (Lean names the last argument F; it is unrelated to the family F of occurringLabels_subsingleton): block 0 of b is the image of e, and every k in GL_n(O_w) block triangular mod w for b with block 0 equal to x sends f to prod_l chi_l(det of block l+1 mod w) psi(det x) Phi(x).

imports.name: HasParahoricType.hasProductLabel
imports.lean:
lemma HasParahoricType.hasProductLabel {f hw e y b c ψ} {χ : Fin s → _} (L : V →ₗ[ℂ] Gf E n →
  M → ℂ) (hL : Injective L) (h₂ : σ.asAlgebraHom (labelIdem ρ c) y ≠ 0) (h :
  HasParahoricType f hw e b ψ χ (L <| σ · y)) (hχ : Injective χ) : let T := faithfulChar (ResField
    w); let a := c.scaleRoots (charName T ψ); (∀ l, ¬a.IsRoot
      (charName T (χ l)).1) → HasProductLabel f hw T (card ρ) a χ (card {i // b i = ·.succ}) := by
imports.text: Type implies label (Frobenius reciprocity): let L be an injective linear map into functions on G_f, y a vector with labelIdem(rho, c) y != 0 (c a polynomial over k_w, the idempotent acting through sigma), HasParahoricType(f, w, e, b, psi, chi, g -> L(sigma(g) y)) and chi injective. Put T = faithfulChar(k_w) and c' = c.scaleRoots(charName(T, psi)). If no x_{chi_l} = charName(T, chi_l) is a root of c', then HasProductLabel(f, w, T, |rho|, c', chi, t) with t_l = #{i : b(i) = l + 1} (the block sizes).

imports.name: HasProductLabel
imports.text: HasProductLabel(f, hw, T, d, c, chi, t): c is a label of degree d, c prod_l (X - x_{chi_l}) is separable, d + sum t_l = n, and f has the label Xi_c * prod_l(chi_l o det on GL_{t_l}) at w.

  IsTameExponent w A T (f)! s a ∧ (s = hA.tameGenerator → a.Coprime (w.q ^ (f)! - 1)) := by

  ∃ ξ : AlgebraicClosure k, c.aeval ξ = 0 ∧ IsPrimitiveRoot ξ (.card k ^ r - 1)

imports.name: IsPrimitiveLabel.isPrimitiveRoot_prod_roots
imports.lean:
lemma IsPrimitiveLabel.isPrimitiveRoot_prod_roots (hc : IsPrimitiveLabel r c) :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (c.aroots (AlgebraicClosure k)).prod (.card k - 1) ∧ ∃ e, ∀ ξ ∈ c.aroots
  (AlgebraicClosure k), ξ ^ e = (c.aroots _).prod := have ⟨⟨_, _, rfl, z⟩, I, _, w, h⟩ := hc
imports.text: For a primitive label c of degree r the product of its roots (in the algebraic closure of k) is a primitive (|k| - 1)-th root of unity, and for one exponent e every root xi satisfies xi^e = that product. (An individual root has order |k|^r - 1, by the definition of IsPrimitiveLabel.)

imports.name: sphericalCompat_std
imports.lean:
lemma sphericalCompat_std {ℓ E n} [ThePrime ℓ] [PadicIso ℓ] [Field E] [EmbeddedNumberField E]
  [CMType E]
  [Fintype n] [Nonempty n] [WeilData E] w : SphericalCompat E n (card n) w := fun P κ f hf h ↦ by
imports.text: SphericalCompat(E, n, |n|, w) for every finite place w (E with an embedding, a CM type and Weil data, n nonempty finite, l and iota_l fixed): for every family P of Hecke polynomials, weight kappa and algebraic form f on the standard definite space of weight kappa that is an eigenform for P, (a) some l-adic representation r of Gal(Omega/E) of rank |n| is attached to P (Attached: continuous, trace-nondegenerate, and the characteristic polynomials of Frobenius elements approximate iota_l(P(w)) coefficientwise at most Frobenii); (b) for every r attached to P, if the maximal compact subgroup at w fixes f, then for every place A above w: r has good type at A (IsGoodAt: trivial on the inertia group at A when l is a unit at A, and crystalline along every embedding into Q_l-bar inducing A), its jumps at A are those of kappa in rank |n|, and whenever f has Hecke polynomial Q at w (a split place) and s^(-1) is a Frobenius at A, iota_l(Q) kills r(s) (PolyKillsAt; geometric Frobenius away from l, the period Frobenius above l). The authors' doc comment calls it a known result (Galois representations attached to forms on definite unitary groups); the relation to the literature is the second reader's (literature).

  d c} {χ : Fin s → MulChar (ResField w) ℂ} {t} [WeilData E] (hf : f ∈ (stdSpace E n).forms κ) (he :
  IsEigenform f P) (hr : Attached P r) (h : HasProductLabel f hw T d c χ t) (hA : IsPlaceOver A w) :
  IsFiniteTypeAt r A ∧ HasJumpsAt r A (jumps κ (Fintype.card n)) ∧
  IsLabelledAt A T d.factorial (fun s Q ↦ PolyKillsAt r A s Q ∧ (A.valuation
  ℓ = 1 → (r s).1.det = Q.roots.prod)) (c * ∏ l, (X - C (charName T (χ l)).1) ^ t l) := by
imports.text: Let f be an algebraic form of weight kappa on the standard definite space (E with Weil data, n nonempty), an eigenform for the Hecke polynomials P, r an l-adic representation attached to P, w a split place, A a place above w, T an injective character, and assume HasProductLabel(f, w, T, d, c, chi, t) (c a monic squarefree label of degree d with c(0) != 0, c prod_l (X - x_{chi_l}) separable, d + sum_l t_l = |n|, and f has the label Xi_c * prod_l (chi_l o det on GL_{t_l}) at w). Then r has finite type at A (trivial on the inertia elements near 1 when l is a unit at A, potentially crystalline along every embedding into Q_l-bar inducing A), its jumps at A are those of kappa, and IsLabelledAt(A, T, d!, P', c prod_l (X - x_{chi_l})^(t_l)) holds for the predicate P'(s, Q): Q kills r(s) (PolyKillsAt) and, when l is a unit at A, det r(s) is the product of the roots of Q. The authors' doc comment calls it a known result (local-global compatibility at tame level); the relation to the literature is the second reader's (literature).

literature.verdict: The books and papers give parameter compatibility; the compact squarefree-label predicate needs a separate identification

The ordering gives equal semisimplifications and bounds monodromy. Full Frobenius-semisimplified equality is stated at Shin-regular weight. <https://www.numdam.org/item/ASENS_2014__47_1_165_0.pdf#page=7>

R. Taylor and T. Yoshida, Compatibility of local and global Langlands correspondences, Theorem A, J. Amer. Math. Soc. 20 (2007), pp. 467–468, author preprint p. 1. imports.name: Attached
imports.text: Attached(P, ρ, j) takes a family of complex polynomials P_w indexed by the finite places of the CM field E, a representation ρ of a group H with a topology on an n-indexed vector space over the algebraic closure of ℚ_ℓ, and a map j from H to Gal(Ω/E). For H = Gal(Ω/E), j defaults to the identity. The representation is continuous, the trace pairing (X,Y) ↦ tr(XY) is nondegenerate on the linear span of ρ(H), and j is open. For every real η > 0, for most geometric Frobenius data (w,A,s), for every x in H with j(x) = s and every index i, the ℓ-adic distance between coefficient i of the characteristic polynomial of ρ(x) and coefficient i of ι_ℓ(P_w) is at most η. Here most means that each nonempty open subset of Gal(Ω/E) contains a nonempty open subset O such that, outside finitely many w, every Frobenius datum at w with s in O satisfies this condition.
